originality.rationale: Weyman treats orbit-closure ideals with extra characteristic-polynomial invariants, not the power-entry scheme. Prasad–Singla–Spallone already construct the exact differential and its blockwise action (both credited), but their inspected results target extension/similarity classification and do not state the all-partition rank-fiber census or generic-reducedness divisibility. One-block lifted-index distribution is already covered and is explicitly excluded as an independent novelty claim. Priority risk remains for implicit consequences or inaccessible broader sources.
residual_risks: The rank formula is an elementary consequence of Prasad–Singla–Spallone’s prior differential and may have been recorded elsewhere without the present terminology. The entire arithmetic specialization m=2 and every single-block arithmetic case are already covered by earlier work.
The exact divisibility criterion might appear implicitly in older matrix-scheme or local-model literature; no exhaustive proof of absence is possible.
Independent publication-priority and mathematical audits have not occurred.
